notes.title: Epic Jump! Reborn!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It is finally here - Epic Jump, completely reprogrammed.

I had decided to continue developing Epic Jump, but the way I had programmed it two years ago made it complicated to add new stuff without anything else breaking. So, I set out on a mission to reprogram the entire game to make it more versatile and capable of receiving new cool features and maps. Now, the first and longest phase is done, and it is time to develop new maps and features.

[b]Here is a summarized list of the biggest changes:[/b]

· Redesigned UI.
· Added forcefeedback for controllers in some instances. (When player dies or changes level)
· Now you can play with two people either on the same keyboard, with one gamepad, or two gamepads.
· Language support for English, Spanish, and Danish.
· Implemented Steam achievements (many more to come).

[b]Here are some features I will add in the future:[/b]

· Full support for gamepads.
· Steam playtogether
· New and improved maps.
· Fun in-game features like extra points, new mechanics like double jump, etc. (Contact us on [url=https:// discord.gg/VUZjf2BT]discord[/url] to submit your ideas).

Thank you for sticking around, and get ready for a reborn Epic Jump!
Sune H. Wittrup.

notes.title: Development Progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Since I announced that I would resume the development of Epic Jump!, a ton of progress has been made.

[h1]What is being done?[/h1]

·Remade the entire menu to fit a more conventional style.
·Recoded the entire game to easily add new features in the future after the new release.
·Making new levels and features for the game to be more entertaining. (Even more to come)
·Now you will be able to play either with two players on one keyboard and two gamepads. Thanks to Clon.
·Steam achievements.

[h1]Features for the future:[/h1]

Many things can change, and I have plenty of ideas I want to add to make Epic Jump! a larger game (and without bugs).

·More Steam achievements.
·More levels with different styles and new mechanics, and more coop mechanics.
·Select your own character! A few extra characters will be added so you can select who you would like to play as.
·DLCs with extra content.
·This is just the plan for now. Stick around and follow the continued development of Epic Jump!

First update is due for release in April.
If you have any questions or insights, please contact me on our [url=https://discord.gg/u93tBaqS]Discord[/url].

Sune (R4ptor Studios)

notes.title: Epic Jump! Development Resumed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After over a year of silence, I have decided to pick up and continue developing Epic Jump!

I will be redesigning the menu, game mechanics, levels—pretty much everything.

In addition to overhauling it, I am going to expand the game with longer levels, Steam achievements, more personalization, and even create DLC. (Stay tuned!)

For this to happen, I would like your help! I have created a form where you can freely write out your ideas for the game and its improvement.

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeffl9e1nwM4ltiPjVP5YJNuD9ivmdSigb8mFlFxC97I48doQ/viewform]Epic Jump! Your Ideas![/url]

Your input is very much appreciated!

Thank you so much for sticking around.
I will see you soon.
Sune (R4ptor Studios)

notes.title: Final Note
notes.content:
Hello player!

This will be the last news from R4ptor Studios for Epic Jump!

This does not mean that the game will be abandoned entirely. But I have decided to move on and focus on other projects.

I have disabled cloud saves because it created bugs in the scenery and some other more unlikely bugs...

If you want to get in contact (or report issues) please join our [url=https://discord.gg/j8uzG79P]Discord[/url]. See you there. 

Until the next game!
Thank you for playing.
The R4ptor Studios Team.

notes.title: New levels!

The R4ptor Studios Team.

notes.title: Prepare For The Official Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we have released Epic Jump Officially. It will no longer be in early access.

The decision for release so soon was that the basic gameplay is tested and bug-free and there is a fully working multiplayer and the only thing to do now is incrementally add more maps.

Fixes:
· Fixed an error when playing in normal difficulty, when the timer ran out it would spawn players at the beginning of the level and not go back to the main menu.
· Fixed some collision issues on Level 3


What's new?
· Added a new gameplay mechanic where you can walk on some planks that will fall down if you stand on them for too long.
· Added Level 6 and Level 7
· Added sound fx for when being punched by one of the punching rocks.
· Added sound fx for when dropping planks fall down. 
· Added sound fx for when entering the level change portal.
· Added in the options menu an option to visually see the control mappings of the keyboard and the controller.


We hope you enjoy our game.
If you have any suggestions or problems please contact us directly via email or join our discord here [url=https://discord.gg/egyafkqe]Discord[/url].

We hope to see you jumping! 
The R4ptor Studios Team.

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

Today we bring you a small fix for the currently known bugs.

· Now the music will start a different track with every level change. 
· Level 3: Fixed some collision issues. 
· Fixed player points when the difficulty timer would run out there would be a delay before the point was given. Now the points are given immediately after being launched (because of the timer running out).
· Some minor fixes.

If you have any suggestions or problems please report them (preferably) to our [url=https://discord.gg/egyafkqe]Discord[/url]

Thank you for playing!
The R4ptor Studios Team.

notes.title: The Beginning of the Future
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we launch the first major update for Epic Jump!

This includes:
     · Partial controller support.
     · Local multiplayer.
     · Volume options and game saves management.
     · A scoring system.
     · Music and some sounds
And more!

Note: For the local multiplayer to work you must have a second controller (Xbox or similar).

for this update to work correctly it's mandatory that you go to C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local and look for the Epic_Jump folder and completely delete it.
This will erase all your progress but will make the game function as intended.
Once the game is out of early access all the saving files will be saved to the steam cloud.

Levels 6 and 7 are currently disabled because of problems we experienced in them but they will soon be back with levels 8 and 9.

We hope you can enjoy this new update and play it with your friends!
If you have any suggestions or problems please report them (preferably) to our [url=https://discord.gg/egyafkqe]Discord[/url]

The R4ptor Studios team.

notes.title: Multiplayer Implementation!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!

There will soon be a big update implementing local multiplayer (player 1 on keyboard and player 2 on a controller)
Doing this is no easy task so when you get the update please let us know, as always, all the bugs and errors you find.

Besides working on the multiplayer, we are always working on new levels as shown in the main picture of this post.

If you have any suggestions for a level layout let us know by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/kPup2xrP]Discord[/url]! 

We are also working on making the game updatable in small chunks so you won't have to download the whole game every time there is a new update. 

All this and more will be released soon! Stay tuned!

The R4ptor Studios Team.

notes.title: The First Anouncement For Epic Jump
notes.content:
Hello everyone!. 
This will be the first-ever announcement for Epic Jump!

Keep in mind that this game is in early access and will contain unfinished gameplay and bugs.

If you experience any bugs, before reaching out, go to C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local and look for the folder "Epic_Jump" and delete it. 
This will delete your progress and other saved options, but it might fix your bug. If this does not work or there are any other problems with this game please let us know, either on our discord (preferably) or in a discussion. 

We are currently working on the game. We have already added more sounds and music and we are in great progress with new levels.

Please submit your ideas and wishes to our [url=https://discord.gg/kPup2xrP]Discord[/url] server or to our email (see store page).

We won't be updating the game right away as there is no updating functionality implemented to the game itself and therefore the next update will replace the existing game. But more on that when the time comes. 

Thank you for playing Epic Jump!
The R4ptor Studios Team.
